# Advancing governance and public policy through AI.

Designing, developing, and rigorously evaluating AI systems to support better decisions, stronger institutions, and evidence-based public policy.

<div class="hero-links">
  <a class="hero-primary" href="research.qmd">Explore research & ideas</a>

<br>

## Two Complementary Pillars

We explore **both** how AI should be governed **and** how AI can improve governance.

::: {.research-grid .pillar-grid}

::: {.research-card .pillar-card}
<div class="focus-tag">GOVERNANCE OF AI</div>

**How can we ensure AI systems are effective, safe, accountable, and beneficial?**

Research, risk and impact assessment, evidence-based evaluation, and institutional oversight.
:::

::: {.research-card .pillar-card}
<div class="focus-tag focus-tag-sage">AI FOR GOVERNANCE</div>

**How can we design AI systems that improve institutional decisions and public services?**

Human-AI decision support, applied AI systems, GovTech, RegTech, and policy tools.
:::

:::

::: {.integrated-approach}
<div class="eyebrow">ONE INTEGRATED APPROACH</div>

### Design → Develop → Evaluate

The two pillars can work together throughout a project's lifecycle: from understanding institutional challenges and developing AI solutions to evaluating their real-world impact. **Projects may cover the full lifecycle or focus on individual stages.** Governance and empirical evidence inform the process from the beginning.
:::

::: {.lifecycle-grid}

::: {.lifecycle-step}
<div class="step-number">01</div>

### Design

Understand decisions, user needs, potential benefits, and risks.
:::

::: {.lifecycle-step}
<div class="step-number">02</div>

### Develop

Build and integrate AI-enabled tools with human oversight.
:::

::: {.lifecycle-step}
<div class="step-number">03</div>

### Evaluate

Examine effectiveness, fairness, uncertainty, and real-world impact.
:::

:::

## Aligned with Europe's Research Priorities

The Lab's interests intersect with European-funded research and initiatives in adaptive regulation, human-AI collaboration, AI-supported policymaking, and AI-enabled science.

::: {.initiative-grid}

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">MSCA DOCTORAL NETWORK</div>

### [REGULAIRE ↗](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101312218)

How can regulation adapt and learn as technologies evolve?
:::

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">MSCA DOCTORAL NETWORK</div>

### [EMANAIRE ↗](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101311637)

How does AI change human agency, work, and decisions?
:::

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">HORIZON EUROPE PROJECT</div>

### [AI4POL ↗](https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101177455)

How can AI help regulators and policymakers govern technology?
:::

::: {.initiative-card}
<div class="initiative-type">EUROPEAN AI IN SCIENCE INITIATIVE</div>

### [RAISE ↗](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/strategy/strategy-research-and-innovation/our-digital-future/european-ai-science-strategy/raise-resource-ai-science-europe_en)

How can AI accelerate research and scientific discovery?
:::
